scripts.dev: npm run build -w @capsule-claw/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @capsule-claw/shared" "npm run dev -w @capsule-claw/server" "npm run dev -w @capsule-claw/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @capsule-claw/shared && npm run build -w @capsule-claw/server && npm run build -w @capsule-claw/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @capsule-claw/shared && npm run test -w @capsule-claw/server
